nodes.name: turbofish_calls
nodes.docstring:
Turbofish calls name the function they wrap: `s.get::<u32>()` is `s.get`,
and a path's type arguments drop (`TfPool::<u8>::new` is `TfPool::new`),
nested ones and a `->` inside them included.
